binds_contract.verification: binding.verify_contract recomputes every declared sha256; drift is CANNOT_CHECK_CONTRACT_DRIFT, never a pass

cannot_check_rule: CANNOT_CHECK_<reason> must name the missing instrument, never a resource shortage

compute_placement.forbidden_partition_reason: submit-plugin refuses this project on nuc; sinfo and scontrol do not reveal it
compute_placement.network: NONE -- LUNARC performs pure offline compute

enumeration_modes.MULTISET: unordered, C(12+n-1, n); licensed ONLY if permutation_invariance_probe returns PERMUTATION_INVARIANT

falsifiers: F1 a kernel that cannot be ablated from the all-on baseline refutes section 2 independence
F2 a permutation counterexample forbids MULTISET and forces FULL enumeration
F3 a hostile that fires in zero worlds is an instrument hole, not a safe world
F4 a clean arm with zero birth/death events makes the BIO-T1 pass vacuous
F5 a clean control that is not silent invalidates the matching hostile's flip

instruments.fails_when: any frozen sha256 differs or a frozen file is missing
the frozen kernels.assert_independent_ablation ever returns ok=False
two runs of an identical spec differ (must stay silent)
any of the 512 kernel combinations raises
a kernel cannot be flipped from the all-on baseline without raising
a permutation of the initial population changes the trajectory signature
the clean arm never exercises a birth/death decision (VACUOUS_PASS)
a registered hostile fires nowhere, or a clean control is not silent
a registered hostile does not gate the frozen EB-F0 result

no_alarm_controls: identical spec rerun must produce a byte-identical trajectory signature
optional social policy must refuse the junk method (clean control for H-FORCED-COPY / H-PRESTIGE-STALE)
clean (leak=False) world must not report assay_interferes
